tools.name: get_gamma_levels
tools.description: Modeled options dealer-positioning levels for one underlying: gamma flip, call wall, put wall, max pain, same-day pin strike, and net dealer gamma at spot (whose sign is the regime). Use for "where is the gamma flip", "where are the walls", "is SPX in positive gamma". FREE DELAYED DATA - at least 15
